Haus Talk, Inc. (HTI) was registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission originally as Haus Talk Project Managers, Inc. The Company's primary purpose is to acquire land, engage in land and housing development, and participate in the government's mass housing program. The Company adopted its present name on June 7, 2017.

HTI primarily develops horizontal and vertical residential projects in select cities of Metro Manila as well as in Rizal, Laguna, and Cavite provinces.

The Company's subsidiaries include Traditional Homes, Inc. and Lifestyle Development Corporation.

Source: SEC Form 17-A (2024)

## Company: Haus Talk, Inc. (HTI)
Sector: Small, Medium & Emerging Board / Small, Medium & Emerging Board
Haus Talk, Inc. (HTI) was registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission originally as Haus Talk Project Managers, Inc. The Company's primary purpose is to acquire land, engage in land and housing development, and participate in the government's mass housing program. The Company adopted its present name on June 7, 2017.

HTI primarily develops horizontal and vertical residential projects in select cities of Metro Manila as well as in Rizal, Laguna, and Cavite provinces.

The Company's subsidiaries include Traditional Homes, Inc. and Lifestyle Development Corporation.

Source: SEC Form 17-A (2024)
